role: BI Specialist – Financial Reporting & Data Analytics

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Du entwickelst moderne Reporting- und Analytics-Lösungen mit Power BI und gestaltest unser Financial Reporting aktiv mit ('You develop modern reporting and analytics solutions with Power BI and actively help shape our Financial Reporting')
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Responsibilities centre on financial reporting accuracy, structured data architecture, and translating requirements into 'sustainable technical solutions' ('nachhaltige technische Lösungen') with no velocity/speed framing anywhere in the JD, consistent with the audited European tendency toward governance/quality vocabulary.
evidence.domain_risk: Du verstehst Finance- und Controlling-Prozesse und kannst fachliche Anforderungen hinter Zahlen, Reports und Kennzahlen nachvollziehen ('You understand Finance and Controlling processes and can trace the substantive requirements behind figures, reports and KPIs')
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: The role sits directly in financial reporting for Finance & Controlling, but the JD's own language stays at internal reporting/KPI level without explicit regulatory, audit, or statutory compliance framing, placing this at moderate per the tie-breaker.
evidence.collaboration_width: Finance & Controlling; BI-Team; gruppenweites Umfeld (group-wide environment)
evidence.data_team_maturity: Bei Hügli schauen wir, dass wir unsere BI-Landschaft laufend auf den neusten Stand bringen ('At Hügli we make sure we continuously keep our BI landscape up to date')
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: An existing BI landscape, BI team, and Power BI/SAP/Azure tooling are already in place with the role tasked to modernise and rethink reporting, indicating a data function that exists and is actively evolving rather than early-stage or fully mature.
evidence.jd_authorship: Du konzipierst und entwickelst Power-BI-Reports, Datenmodelle und komplexe DAX-Logiken eigenständig weiter ('You independently design and further develop Power BI reports, data models and complex DAX logic')
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Responsibilities name precise technologies and mechanisms (Power BI, DAX logic, SAP FI/CO data, Azure Data Lake, Microsoft Fabric) with concrete application context, reading as written by a hiring manager who understands the actual scope.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Du bist das Bindeglied zwischen Finance & Controlling, Business und IT ('You are the link between Finance & Controlling, Business and IT')
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role's explicit mandate is financial reporting and Finance & Controlling process translation, squarely a finance orientation despite touching Business and IT as well.
evidence.autonomy_level: Reporting neu denken... hilfst dabei, Reporting und Analytics von Grund auf neu zu denken ('Rethink reporting... help rethink reporting and analytics from the ground up')
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role is explicitly framed as rethinking reporting/analytics from scratch with significant creative latitude ('viel Gestaltungsspielraum'), a clearly strategic mandate with no execution-only framing.
evidence.ai_role: Innovation vorantreiben: Du beschäftigst dich mit neuen Technologien und KI-gestützter Entwicklung und bringst diese dort ein, wo sie einen echten Mehrwert für Reporting und Analytics schaffen ('Drive innovation: You engage with new technologies and AI-supported development and introduce them wherever they create real value for reporting and analytics')
evidence.ai_role_explanation: AI is mentioned only as a vague interest area ('AI-supported development... wherever it creates value') rather than a demonstrated skill or expected usage pattern, matching the tie-breaker for vague AI-interest phrases mapping to none.
evidence.testing_framing: No testing or data quality signal present.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: No dedicated testing, data contract, or data-quality-ownership language appears anywhere in the JD.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Du verstehst die fachlichen Anforderungen aus Finance und Controlling und übersetzt diese in nachhaltige technische Lösungen ('You understand the substantive requirements from Finance and Controlling and translate them into sustainable technical solutions')
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: The role centres on trustworthy financial reporting but with no explicit compliance, audit, or regulatory register — 'sustainable' and correctness-adjacent language appears without a dedicated risk narrative, placing this at moderate.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: hilfst dabei, Reporting und Analytics von Grund auf neu zu denken ('help rethink reporting and analytics from the ground up')... Projekte gestalten: Du begleitest Finance-Projekte entlang unserer Financial Roadmap
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The role rethinks reporting from the ground up while also accompanying an existing Financial Roadmap and existing BI landscape, a genuine mix of new build and ongoing evolution.
evidence.language_gate: Du bist kommunikationsstark in Deutsch und Englisch ('You are a strong communicator in German and English')
evidence.work_arrangement: Hybride Arbeitszeit nach Abstimmung ('Hybrid working hours by arrangement'); 1 Tag pro Woche im Mobile Office ('1 day per week in the mobile office')
